name: security-heavy
description: Extends the default review profile with additional authorization, sensitive-data, and abuse-path checks.

common_issues.title: Security-sensitive behavior lacks negative tests or implementation evidence.
Sensitive data can leak through logs, responses, or persistence.

design.title: Authorization boundary map
design.description: Reviewer must identify actors, roles, tenant boundaries, ownership checks, and privileged operations affected by the change.

design.title: Sensitive data flow
design.description: Reviewer must trace whether tokens, PII, credentials, payment data, or business secrets enter logs, responses, persistence, or external calls.

test.title: Authorization negative matrix
test.description: Reviewer must confirm tests cover denied roles, wrong tenant/resource ownership, unauthenticated calls, and privilege escalation attempts.

test.title: Sensitive data regression
test.description: Reviewer must check tests or assertions prevent sensitive data from appearing in logs, API responses, events, or stored fields.

implementation.title: Authorization enforcement
implementation.description: Reviewer must verify production code enforces the documented authorization boundaries at the actual entry points and not only in helper code.

implementation.title: Sensitive data handling
implementation.description: Reviewer must verify masking, omission, encryption, retention, and external propagation behavior for sensitive fields touched by the change.
